data: Die Brüder Mirko (Lucas Gregorowicz) und Letscho (Frederick Lau) erben von ihrem Vater einen Schrottplatz, der jedoch kurz vor dem Ruin steht. Während Letscho noch immer dort tätig ist, hat Mirko inzwischen eine erfolgreiche Karriere als Versicherungskaufmann gestartet, mit der er seine Vergangenheit eigentlich hinter sich lassen wollte. Doch eine aktuelle berufliche Krise und die Überzeugungskraft alter Bekannter bringen ihn schließlich dazu, wider Willen in seine Heimat zurückzukehren, wo Letscho, der noch immer sauer darüber ist, dass sein Bruder die Familie einst im Stich gelassen hat, auf ihn wartet. Trotz aller Differenzen sehen die Geschwister bald ein, dass sie sich zusammenraufen müssen, um die Existenz ihrer strauchelnden Familie zu sichern. Ein noch von ihrem Vater geplanter, waghalsiger Überfall auf einen Zug soll ihnen zum dringend benötigten Geld verhelfen... (Brothers Mirko (Lucas Gregorowicz) and Letscho (Frederick Lau) inherit a scrapyard from their father, which is on the verge of ruin. While Letscho still works there, Mirko has since embarked on a successful career as an insurance salesman, with which he originally intended to put his past behind him. However, a recent professional crisis and the persuasive powers of old acquaintances ultimately force him to reluctantly return to his hometown, where Letscho, still angry about his brother's abandonment of the family, is waiting for him. Despite all their differences, the siblings soon realize that they must work together to secure the existence of their struggling family. A daring train robbery, planned by their father, is intended to provide them with the money they desperately need...)

Brothers Mirko (Lucas Gregorowicz) and Letscho (Frederick Lau) inherit a scrapyard from their father, which is on the verge of ruin. While Letscho still works there, Mirko has since embarked on a successful career as an insurance salesman, with which he originally intended to put his past behind him. However, a recent professional crisis and the persuasive powers of old acquaintances ultimately force him to reluctantly return to his hometown, where Letscho, still angry about his brother's abandonment of the family, is waiting for him. Despite all their differences, the siblings soon realize that they must work together to secure the existence of their struggling family. A daring train robbery, planned by their father, is intended to provide them with the money they desperately need...
